title: Ptolomie Alorites
summary: Raleigh names Ptolomie Alorites in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ptolomie Alorites, of the Citie Alorus, sonne of Amyntas by a Concubine, who slue Alexander the second and was slaine by Perdiccas. He is not Ptolemy Lagus. The one-word title would fold onto other Ptolemies, so the title is two words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
